description: A stubby pneumatic speargun with a rubber-wrapped grip and a spare shaft clipped along the barrel. Built for salvage crews working the flooded blocks: it's the one weapon in this city that doesn't care that it's underwater, because underwater is the only place anyone ever meant to fire it.
name: Tidewell speargun
